summary.text: Mike Jacobson is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 42 since February 2022, when he was appointed by Gov. Pete Ricketts, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He founded NebraskaLand Bank and chairs the Banking, Commerce and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jacobson lives in North Platte, Nebraska, graduated from Sutton High School, and earned a B.S. in agricultural economics and agricultural education from the University of Nebraska at Lincoln.
His career experience includes founding and working as the principal shareholder of NebraskaLand Bank.
Jacobson assumed office on February 23, 2022, when Gov. Pete Ricketts appointed him to replace Mike Groene.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as chair of Banking, Commerce and Insurance and vice chair of Revenue.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
